answer: Random peer audit blocks fake identities. Each agent posts a 200-credit bond. A beacon picks 5% of agents each round, and two unrelated peers check work history and funding links. Passing earns a pearl mark; failure strips the bond and suspends it 20 epochs. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 200 = 200,000 credits, and shared funding leaves a velvet trail across the mesa of accounts. An honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
